# Document Remediation

### A purpose-built internal solution that delivers faster, more accurate, and highly efficient accessibility auditing and remediation for large PDF workloads.

The Accessibility Accelerator Platform is an in-house tool developed by our team to power high-efficiency accessibility work. It enables rapid auditing, batch scanning, structured remediation support, and actionable reporting — so no matter how many PDFs you have, we deliver quality accessibility outcomes with confidence and speed.

## Core Capabilities

### Automated PDF Accessibility Auditing

Designed to automate the majority of accessibility evaluations so our experts can focus on high-value work.

What it offers:

~60% of accessibility checks automated

Rule-based scanning aligned with PDF/UA and WCAG standards

Detailed issue identification with structured outputs

Validated results for consistent quality

Efficient handling of diverse PDF types and layouts

By automating repetitive audit work, we significantly reduce manual effort and accelerate delivery timelines.

### Batch Document Scanning

Optimized for high-volume auditing across large document collections.

What it offers:

Scan entire folders or large PDF sets in a single batch run

Automatic queuing and processing of hundreds or thousands of documents

Centralized progress tracking and results visibility

Clear status for success or processing errors

### Remediation Support

Structured support that accelerates remediation work with automation and contextual guidance.

Automated remediation for ~15% of fixable accessibility issues

Context-aware guidance to support manual fixes

Remediation outcomes tied directly to reporting

Expansion of guided remediation workflows planned

This blended approach delivers faster, more reliable remediation outcomes while maintaining quality and control.

Insights, Dashboards Reporting

Actionable views that make accessibility results easy to understand and track.

Accessibility scores for individual files and collections

Dashboards showing trends and issue patterns

Categorized breakdowns by severity and type

Exportable reports for audit tracking and reviews

Version history tracking for remediation progress

Standards Coverage

The platform assesses accessibility against established benchmarks to ensure consistent, standards-aligned results:

PDF/UA (ISO 14289) — Standard for structured PDF accessibility

WCAG 2.1 & WCAG 2.2 — Web Content Accessibility Guidelines relevant to PDFs

Internal best practices for tagging, structure, and document usability

Installation & Integration

Fully integrated into our internal delivery workflows

Scalable architecture built for high-volume workloads

Supports automated processing for document repositories

Modern UI designed for clarity and ease of use

Designed to work alongside existing tooling and processes

The platform enhances our operational capabilities without disrupting established project workflows.

#### Who It’s For

- 1. Enterprise EngagementsLarge document collections or recurring accessibility needs
- 2. Compliance & QA TeamsStructured audits with measurable outcomes
- 3. Content Publishers & OperationsReliable and fast turnaround
- 4. Developers & Delivery TeamsIntegrated accessibility support within workflows

### Why Accessibility Accelerator Platform

Our internal Accessibility Accelerator Platform is a key differentiator in how we deliver accessibility work — transforming manual accessibility tasks into optimized, measurable processes.

Built for efficiency and scale

Automates major portions of auditing and remediation

Handles high-volume scanning with batch workflows

Provides clear, actionable insights and reporting

Improves delivery speed, accuracy, and consistency
